name: The Errand
description: Four checks in the city. None gates the scene, and none costs anything mechanical.

outcomes.criticalSuccess: She walks them to the door: "Manako. Tea house, few streets on. Tell him I sent you." They arrive half-trusted.
outcomes.success: Cheerful, no help, and the name: "Ask Manako."
outcomes.failure: The docket is somebody else's problem. A voice from the back says, "Ask Manako."
outcomes.criticalFailure: She calls them "the Directorate" for the rest of the visit, the way you'd say "the electric company". Someone still says, "Ask Manako."

bySkill.diplomacy: She warms up: "...Oh. You asked properly."
bySkill.deception: She sees straight through it and enjoys it. Now she's in on the joke.
bySkill.intimidation: She gets flatter, not more helpful: "Scare tactics. In my workshop. On a Monday."

outcomes.criticalSuccess: Like every one they've seen, it's where a crowd stands and waits. Somebody is choosing these walls.
outcomes.success: Somebody has been doing this for a while.
outcomes.failure: It looks like paint, nothing more.
outcomes.criticalFailure: They decide it's a tram company mark, and say so with confidence.

bySkill.occultism: Drawn the way a working mark is drawn: one careful stroke, as if it has to be right.
bySkill.crafting: Marine primer again, the kind ships' chandlers sell by the tin.
bySkill.society: Always on walls nobody minds and nobody paints over.

outcomes.criticalSuccess: The Directorate scientist who had a breakdown at a science conference, caused a huge fuss, and was expelled. Nothing about why.
outcomes.success: A chemist, disgraced, a long time ago.
outcomes.criticalFailure: They're sure they've heard it, and can't place it.

outcomes.criticalSuccess: As success, and he notices being looked at, and isn't used to it. He has decided he likes this one.
outcomes.success: A man who has been very good at something and stopped, and minds.
outcomes.failure: A kind old man with a good coat.
outcomes.criticalFailure: A faint conviction that he is nobody much. Let it stand.

bySkill.perception: He reads the docket the way a musician reads music: not working it out, hearing it.
bySkill.medicine: Old chemical stains on two fingers that never wash out, and a tremor he has learned to steady.

outcomes.criticalSuccess: As success, and when he speaks, the room lowers its voice without being asked.
outcomes.success: People come to his table to ask him things, a lease, a quarrel, a job, and he settles each in a sentence. He matters round here.
outcomes.failure: A tea house full of regulars, fond of the old man in the corner.
outcomes.criticalFailure: They decide he's a lonely old man the regulars humour.

notes: No roll decides whether they reach Manako or get his help. His number goes to a player who was kind, at the GM's call, never on a roll. The mark, his name and reading him are rolled blind: their critical failures are beliefs.
